_sobre: Um arquivo por idioma. Para criar outro: copie en.json para <código>.json (ex.: fr.json), traduza os valores (nunca as chaves) e acrescente a seção do código em mecanicas/traducoes.json. Textos que faltarem aparecem em inglês.

interface.arraste: {nome}: drag · click the padlock to lock
interface.dica_alt: In game, hold Alt to click the padlock and the gear.
interface.dica_janela: Play in windowed or borderless mode (fullscreen hides the overlay).
interface.instalando: Installing: Nebula Overlay will restart by itself.
interface.erro_npcap: Npcap is not installed. It is needed to read the game connection.
interface.erro_loopback: The game goes through {proxy}, but Npcap was installed without "Support loopback traffic". Reinstall Npcap with that option checked.
interface.erro_placa: Couldn't pick the game's network adapter.
interface.eventos_voz: Speak the warning (or ring a bell)
interface.eventos_nota: The schedule predicts the next ones; when the event opens, the exact time comes from the server. Custom schedule: mecanicas/eventos.json in the Nebula Overlay folder.
interface.sem_voz: no {idioma} voice in Windows: using beeps. Install it in Windows Settings → Time & language → Speech.
interface.reiniciar_aviso: Size and panels apply after a restart.
interface.vale_proximo: Class, role and burst apply from the next boss.
interface.aprender: Learn boss timelines from my captures
interface.rodando: Running… this can take a few minutes.
interface.atualizar_auto: Update automatically when a new version comes out
interface.aviso_legal: Free, unofficial fan project, not affiliated with NCSOFT. Aion 2 and the class symbols belong to NCSOFT. Nebula Overlay only reads the network traffic that already reaches your PC and does not touch the game; even so, the game's terms forbid third-party programs: use at your own risk.
